0022600135.text: The Pacers, 2-2 and 0-1 at home, host the 3-1 Philadelphia 76ers in Indiana's fifth game of the 2026-27 season. Indiana sits 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back and 8th in the East, and has lost its most recent game, while Philadelphia, 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, has also dropped its last game after winning its previous three. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Andrew Nembhard is day-to-day with neck soreness and a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost their season series 0-4, including a 105-94 loss in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
